asked.item: Is TikTok analytics broken on my account / Claude can't filter TikTok
Can it rank my LinkedIn posts too

verdict.reason: The pages say the MCP top-posts tool doesn't cover TikTok, the REST API does, and LinkedIn analytics aren't available yet.

steps.text: The blotatolisttopposts MCP tool currently ranks posts from Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and Bluesky.
The MCP filter list is narrower than the backend's collection coverage, and TikTok analytics are supported.
Use the REST API for top-post rankings on TikTok, YouTube, or Pinterest.
Analytics for LinkedIn are not available yet, so Blotato can't rank your LinkedIn posts.
For LinkedIn, use LinkedIn's native analytics for now.
